{{Top|leg}}
The '''Firaxa Room''' was a dining center of [[Ahto Luxury Resorts]]. Its chief chef, [[Alhond Robari]], specialized in cooking [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] for [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] guests.
